basic.name: Powerslide
basic.description: Slide to a location dealing 105~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1.25 seconds.

basic.name: Face Melt
basic.description: Deals 68~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back.

basic.name: Guitar Solo
basic.description: Regenerate 66~~0.04~~ Health per second for 4 seconds.

heroic.name: Mosh Pit
heroic.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

heroic.name: Stage Dive
heroic.description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

trait.name: Rockstar
trait.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Heroic Abilities grant 50 Armor.

activable.name: Imposing Presence
activable.description:
Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

activable.name: Power of the Horde
activable.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds, increased by 2% for each other allied Hero in the area.

activable.name: Ride the Lightning
activable.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location and deal 48~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemy Heroes. The cooldown is reduced by 10 second for every enemy Hero hit, up to 50 seconds.

level1.name: Guitar Hero
level1.description: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks. Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

level1.name: Prog Rock
level1.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100

Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50~~0.04~~ Health every second while it is active.

level1.name: Block Party
level1.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

level4.name: Crowd Surfer
level4.description: Allows Powerslide to travel over walls and terrain. If no enemies are hit, reduce the cooldown by 6 seconds and refund the Mana cost.

level4.name: Loud Speakers
level4.description: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

level4.name: Speed Metal
level4.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

level7.name: Pinball Wizard
level7.description: Hitting an enemy with Powerslide causes the next Face Melt against them within 2 seconds to deal 300% more damage.

level7.name: Hammer-on
level7.description: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks deal 12% more damage, increased to 36% while Guitar Solo is active.

level7.name: Echo Pedal
level7.description: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18~~0.04~~ damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.

level10.name: Stage Dive
level10.description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

level13.name: Mic Check
level13.description: Hitting at least 2 targets with Face Melt reduces its cooldown by 6 seconds.

level13.name: Encore
level13.description:
Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.

Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.

level13.name: Face Smelt
level13.description: Face Melt Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds.

level16.name: Show Stopper
level16.description: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

level16.name: Aggressive Shredding
level16.description: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Guitar Solo by 0.75 seconds.

level20.description: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

level20.name: Crowd Pleaser
level20.description: Stage Dive's impact area is 50% bigger, and its Slow is increased by 30%.

level20.name: Death Metal
level20.description: Upon dying, a ghost uses Mosh Pit at E.T.C's location.
